title: Accept relay contract v9 and follow it: finding kinds, spec check, UI pass, approval and landing, ledger wait phase, conformance JSON

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Owner asked on 2026-10-26 to unify slicer's relay contract with ork's improvements. Slicer 1.16.0 ships contract v9 and slicer's main after that tag ships v10 (s402, s405); the slicer installed here is 1.15.0 (v8). Audit 2026-10-28 (read-only, against slicer origin/main extracted to .scratch/slicer-v10): finding kinds, ff-only landing and the foreground-run wording already match; ork needs the accepted set, the contract JSON, ledger role names, the wait phase, ledger ask/answer, and the fail reason. Owner decisions 2026-10-28 (interactive): (1) accept v9 and v10 (not v7/v8; v10-only ledger features such as --reason are gated on the version ork reads from the slicer it runs); (2) keep ork's vendor-limit rule (fall back on a limit and on an error exit, decision 156) and record it as a deviation; the owner will get v10's rule changed upstream for the next slicer release; (3) mirror blocker owner questions into slicer's ledger with relay-run ask and answer, besides ork's own flow. Owner must upgrade the installed slicer to a v9 or v10 build before ork S142 runs against the real tool.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: TestAcceptedContractsAreV9AndV10; TestPromptsFirstLineNamesTheirContract; TestRelayContractJSONConformance (decode ai relay --json; refuse when finding_kinds or a needed conformance key is missing); TestContractCheckPassesRootAndReportsPinMismatch (exit 3 contract_mismatch); TestUIPassStepRecordsRoleUI; TestSpecCheckRecordsLedgerRunWithRoleSpecCheck (begin on the batch, step with no parent, end pass or stopped); TestAwaitingApprovalRecordsApprovalWait and TestApproveRecordsStartAgain; TestOwnerQuestionPauseRecordsOwnerWaitAndAsk (relay-run ask on the question, answer when answered in ork); TestVendorLimitFallbackRecordsFailReasonOnV10 (and omits --reason on v9); TestOutOfCreditsSkipsSameVendorRows and TestRateLimitTakesTheNextRow; TestRunTreeRendersWaitPhase (not a spinner, not stale); TestGateCriteriaComeFromTheContractJSON.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Tests first; re-anchor every line number from the code (the audit cites internal/roles/roles.go:36,59; engine.go:228-235; round.go:329-354,527-551; states.go:36-43,523-526,556,687-689; write.go:33-40,131-155; types.go:132-152,177; doctor.go:240-259). 1. Contract: AcceptedContracts = [9 10], ContractVersion 10; Client.Contract passes --root and reports exit 3 contract_mismatch with the pin; add Client.RelayContract decoding `ai relay --json` (contract, pinned, changes, roles[].ledger_role, finding_kinds, gate.criteria and verdicts, conformance keys, outcomes); doctor and engine New validate it (finding kinds are exactly fix/owner/later, every conformance key ork implements is present) and take ledger role names and gate criteria from it instead of restating them; keep the contract version the run used in runrec.Contract and READ it to gate v10-only flags. 2. Prompts: re-read each prompt in internal/roles/prompts against the v10 relay-orchestrator text and brief rules, set the first lines to v10, align the gate criteria wording (`fix` finding of medium severity or worse; no blocker owner finding) and the foreground wording (runs its own shell commands in the foreground and backgrounds none); re-seeding is the prompt owner's call under roles.prompt-seed, so list the changed lines in the report. 3. Ledger roles: write --role ui for the UI pass (drop the reviewer mapping at round.go:531-534 and the TUI re-map) and record the spec check as a ledger run on its batch with --role spec-check and no parent. 4. Wait phase: add WaitingOn, Reason and Question to StepSpec and Step and Waiting to Counts; on a pause for an owner question and on awaiting approval record --phase wait --waiting-on owner|approval on the orchestrator step, --phase start again on answer, approve or retry; mirror blocker questions with relay-run ask and answer; the TUI phase switches (runtree, relayboard, overview, progress) render wait as waiting, not running and not stale; update the --active comment. 5. Vendor limit: on v10 pass --reason with the classified message on the failed fallback step; split out of credits from rate limit (new classification) and skip later rows of the same vendor on out of credits; ork's fallback on an error exit stays (decision 156) and is documented in design.md as a deviation from v10 with the switch named on the run card. 6. Docs: boundaries.md:33-45 (accepted set, drop the stale v7 text), design.md (626-627, 656-660, 737-741, 1117-1123), glossary.md (9, 145-149), AGENTS.md:104-105. Not in this slice: relay-run stats (S123, v1.1), Claude background-tool restrictions. UI slice: UI pass (r14).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./...; go vet; gofmt -l; ork doctor against a v9 and a v10 fake; slicer check; adj lint.
